acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

params.unstakeDelaySec: - The unstake delay for this paymaster. Can only be increased.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

params.actualGasCost: - Actual cost of gas used so far (without this postOp call).
params.actualUserOpFeePerGas: - the gas price this UserOp pays. This value is based on the UserOp's maxFeePerGas                        and maxPriorityFee (and basefee)                        It is not the same as tx.gasprice, which is what the bundler pays.
params.context: - The context value returned by validatePaymasterUserOp
params.mode: - Enum with the following options:                        opSucceeded - User operation succeeded.                        opReverted  - User op reverted. The paymaster still has to pay for gas.                        postOpReverted - never passed in a call to postOp().

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.uniswapFee: Fee tier of the token's Uniswap V3 pool with WETH,        used for pricing. Ignored when disallowing.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

params.maxCost: - The maximum cost of this transaction (based on maximum gas and gas price from userOp).
params.userOpHash: - Hash of the user's request data.

returns.context: - Value to send to a postOp. Zero length to signify postOp is not required.
returns.validationData: - Signature and time-range of this operation, encoded the same as the return                          value of validateUserOperation.                          <20-byte> aggregatorOrSigFail - 0 for valid signature, 1 to mark signature failure,                                                    other values are invalid for paymaster.                          <6-byte> validUntil - Last timestamp this operation is valid at, or 0 for "indefinitely"                          <6-byte> validAfter - first timestamp this operation is valid                          Note that the validation code cannot use block.timestamp (or block.number) directly.

params.withdrawAddress: - The address to send withdrawn value.

SIMULATE_SLOT().notice: Slot of the simulation flag, which skips the fee check. Never written on-chain. Only read when the fee is short, so simulation costs slightly more.

addStake(uint32).notice: Add stake for this paymaster. This method can also carry eth value to add to the current stake.

deposit().notice: Add a deposit for this paymaster, used for paying for transaction fees.

getDeposit().notice: Return current paymaster's deposit on the entryPoint.

markupBps().notice: Markup charged on top of the quoted gas cost, in basis points.

oraclePools(address).notice: The Uniswap V3 pool (vs WETH) used to price each allowed ERC20 fee token. ETH and WETH are always allowed and need no pool.

postOp(uint8,bytes,uint256,uint256).notice: Post-operation handler. Must verify sender is the entryPoint.

quoteWeiInToken(address,uint256).notice: Quotes `weiAmount` in `feeToken`, including the markup. ETH and WETH are 1:1. Other tokens use their Uniswap V3 TWAP and revert unless allowed.

setFeeToken(address,uint24,bool).notice: Allows or disallows an ERC20 as a fee token.

setInstance(address,bool).notice: Allows or disallows a Tornado instance.

setMarkup(uint256).notice: Sets the markup charged on top of the gas cost.

sweep(address).notice: Sends this contract's ETH balance to `to`. Doesn't touch the EntryPoint deposit; use `withdrawTo` for that.

sweepERC20(address,address).notice: Sends this contract's balance of `token` to `to`.

unlockStake().notice: Unlock the stake, in order to withdraw it. The paymaster can't serve requests once unlocked, until it calls addStake again

validatePaymasterUserOp((address,uint256.notice: Payment validation: check if paymaster agrees to pay. Must verify sender is the entryPoint. Revert to reject this request. Note that bundlers will reject this method if it changes the state, unless the paymaster is trusted (whitelisted). The paymaster pre-pays using its deposit, and receive back a refund after the postOp method returns.

withdrawStake(address).notice: Withdraw the entire paymaster's stake. stake must be unlocked first (and then wait for the unstakeDelay to be over)
